dataset_level.note: Legitimate, licensed, well-formed source WITH the direct respiratory-belt reference our frozen contract requires — the key advantage over EXT-RR-MULTI-001.

CLM-RR-001.why: Single stationary adult, no second person present — matches activities 1-4 (sitting/lying still, normal + faster breathing). This is the primary route to a first scored E1.
caveats: 10 Hz radar frame rate vs 20 Hz simulator; estimators operate at the data fs, no rule change

CLM-RR-002.why: The claim requires periodic NON-respiratory motion >= respiratory amplitude. The dataset has subject restlessness/free movement (activities 5-6), not controlled periodic apparatus motion. Do not invent it from ordinary recordings.

CLM-RR-003.why: Empty-room calibration recordings (Calibration_emptyRoom_*node*.bin) provide genuine target-absent data.
caveats: few independent empty-room recordings -> the 0.001 target-absent upper bound needs ~3000 independent windows; likely INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE for the frozen bound. Report window/recording-level and mark insufficient rather than forcing a pass.

CLM-RR-004.why: Single-person dataset (one participant per recording; three radars are not three people). No simultaneous multi-person data.

CLM-RR-004B.why: Same — no simultaneous multi-person, person-specific respiratory truth. RR-004B external confirmation remains blocked (Track B).

execution_prerequisites.format: Radar .bin uses the Dopplium format with parameters embedded in the file; requires porting/using the Dopplium parser (Dopplium/dopplium-parser). The EXT-RR-MULTI-001 readDCA1000 adapter does NOT apply.
execution_prerequisites.storage: Total 140.8 GB; per-participant zips 6.6-9.4 GB (extracted ~13-19 GB). Exceeds this environment's ~30 GB working disk. A full scored E1/E2 campaign must run where >= ~50 GB working disk is available; a single participant is borderline feasible.
execution_prerequisites.checksums: 4TU API exposes no per-file md5; compute + record hashes on download and bind to the DataCite record.

recommended_next_action: Track A: on an environment with adequate disk, port the Dopplium parser into a versioned adapter (mendeley pattern), download one participant (smallest zip), decode activities 1-4 for CLM-RR-001, construct the belt reference (freeze protocol first), isolate truth, and score -> earn E1 (a valid FAIL/ABSTAIN also earns E1), then a clean rerun for E2. Keep RR-004/004B as CLAIM_NOT_APPLICABLE.
